title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: It keeps getting better: it submits an edit only when its own tests support it, each edit replacing the last, and over its first eight such sessions its accuracy only rises.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: And the ability emerges with scale: across four sizes of one family, the 2B model makes no edit and the 4B and 9B models break themselves; only the 27B model works on itself as a human would, comparing its hidden states on answers that finish and on answers that run out of tokens, weakening the direction that separates them.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better.
